The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a workstation used to squeeze juice from various fruits, or oil from [[Hemp|hemp seeds]] and [[fat]]. A [[zombie]] may not be stationed at this workstation, meaning it can only be operated manually or by using {{Techpoint|soul}}.
